source: FIGURES.md adapted for clubs, 2026-11-08, as for the NYC, Paris and Amsterdam guides. S4 consensus: Time Out 'The best clubs in Chicago for dancing' (8 Dec 2025, 19 entries, read in full), 6AM '40 best house and techno clubs in North America' (2023), DJ Mag Top 100 Clubs 2026 (Radius at 79). Podlasie, Le Nocturne, Sound-Bar and Prysm are from Time Out, each with a second confirmation (Podlasie's own history, Drumcode sets recorded at Prysm and Radius, Choose Chicago on house venues). Reddit r/chicagoEDM was not read.
